note_summary:
45-year-old female admitted for elective laparoscopic cholecystectomy. Surgery uneventful, no intraoperative complications. Vital signs stable throughout post-operative course. Pain well-controlled with PRN oral analgesics. Tolerating regular diet. No signs of infection or bleeding.

Plan: discharge home today with surgical follow-up in 2 weeks. Patient educated on wound care, activity restrictions, and warning signs requiring return.

alerts.message: Hemoglobin 11.5 g/dL — mild post-operative anemia. Consider iron studies if persistent on follow-up.
